semantics.defaults: Native complete ships contain default_modules and zero bare weapon stats; count each selected default once.
semantics.module_manpower: Native ship_deck_space declares manpower outside add_stats; this is a separate once-only module crew contribution.
semantics.classification: Native ship_medium_battery modules add capital_ship to the cruiser role. Native deck adds capital_ship to carrier.
semantics.detection: 00_defines.lua:2185–2188 records reworked detection/visibility formula; older preceding formulas are marked deprecated. Not a native result.
semantics.upkeep: dynamic_variables_documentation.md documents num_ships and num_ships_with_type, including carrier/capital/screen/submarine; commissioned aggregate, not per-hull telemetry.
